item.tib: theg chen ngo sprod dbyings rig rang grol
item.coloph: de ltar nyams len ngo sprod 'di ni bka' lung spyi dang rje rnams kyi gsung la gzhi byed (byas) 'di ni/ gter grogs dbang mo dang / dbal sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin/ drang srong tshul khrims mchog rgyal/ dngos slob g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas dpal ldan ye shes dgon du dbang lung rgya cher 'chad skabs su bris pa'o//
